# CS2 Developer Reference: Copilot workspace context

This repository is a documentation generator and static site for Counter-Strike 2,
not a plugin, SDK or runtime. `docs/generate_docs.py` reads one
[CS2OpenDev-SchemaTracker](https://github.com/CS2OpenDev/CS2OpenDev-SchemaTracker)
artifact set plus the hand-edited overlays in `docs/overlays/` and writes
`docs/generated/` (Markdown, the JSON schemas under `downstream-codegen-schemas/`,
and the `data/` bundle). The Astro site in `site/` renders from that JSON and is
published to GitHub Pages.

`AGENTS.md` at the repository root is the canonical context file for AI tools: the
schema facts, the artifact URLs and how to read them. Load that, not this file, when
working on a consumer of the docs.

## Hard rules

- Never hand-edit anything under `docs/generated/` or `docs/index.md`. Every file
  there is overwritten by the next generator run; change the generator or an overlay.
- The site reads only `docs/generated/downstream-codegen-schemas/cs2_schema.json` and
  `docs/generated/data/*.json`, never the generated Markdown. The sidebar in
  `site/astro.config.mjs` is hand-written; do not switch it to an autogenerated one.

## Running the generator locally

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch latest \
  https://github.com/CS2OpenDev/CS2OpenDev-SchemaTracker.git upstream/schema-tracker
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
python3 docs/generate_docs.py --repo-root . \
  --artifacts-root ./upstream/schema-tracker/artifacts --build latest \
  --platform windows-x86_64 --output docs --strict
python3 -m unittest discover -s docs/tests -t docs/tests
```

`upstream/schema-tracker/` is gitignored; `--artifacts-root` accepts any SchemaTracker
checkout. See `README.md` for the site commands and `docs/overlays/README.md` for the
overlay format.
